chapters.text: Need a passport or visa photo? With PixPassVisa, prepare your photo online, review the result, and purchase your download when you are ready.
Start by choosing your destination and document. Passport and visa applications can have different photo sizes and upload rules. Always check the instructions for your application.
Upload a recent, genuine photograph. Face the camera in even light, keep your face clearly visible, and avoid face filters. Follow your authority's rules on photo editing.

Review the crop, background, and automated photo checks. If the original is blurry or poorly lit, take another photo. Automated checks help identify issues, but the issuing authority decides acceptance.
Review your fixed local price before checkout. Your paid photo package includes a processed digital photo and printable sheet. An expert manual edit is available separately. There is no subscription.
Ready for your next application? Visit pixpassvisa dot com to create your photo and review the packages. You will find the link in the description.
